# Target 55 frontier

## Uniform finite theorem

If a finite positive transfer amplitude satisfies `m <= T_ij <= M`, its
principal eigenfunction obeys

```text
max(psi)/min(psi) <= M/m.
```

After normalizing `V=max(psi)/psi`, one has `1<=V<=M/m`, so every probability
root law has `nu(V)<=M/m`.

## Obstruction

Finite Perron positivity is not enough. In the two-sector family
`[[1,e^-L],[e^-L,2e^-2L]]`, the inverse vacuum ratio grows exponentially and
the entrywise Harnack constant deteriorates still faster.

## First open physical implication

Prove a cutoff-, volume-, chart-, and history-uniform Harnack or an alternative
weighted root-moment theorem for the complete nonlinear retained `SU(2)`
transfer object. A global entrywise minorization is likely too strong; a
sector/local-chain comparison may be required.

Claim ceiling: C2 finite Harnack theorem.
